<entry id="H00333">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>sick; a patient</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 10
<sup>a</sup> לך ובקר את הח' go and visit the sick (King). Ib. 54
<sup>b</sup> מי שהיה ח' וכ' he who has been sick and recovered. Ib. bot. ח' חתן וכ' a sick person, a bridegroom &c.; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. חוֹלִים, חוֹלִין</plural-form>. Cant. R. to II, 5 ח' מן השעבוד suffering from oppression. Gitt. 28
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. רוב ח' לחיים the majority of the sick recover again. Ib. 61
<sup>a</sup> מבקרין חוֹלֵי נכרים וכ' you are bound to visit the sick of the gentile community alike with &c.; a. fr.—ביקור ח', v. בִּיקּוּר.—
<italic>Fem.</italic> חוֹלָה. Sot. 36
<sup>b</sup> ח' היא that she was sick.—Midr. Till. to Ps. XLVIII, 14 (play on לחילה, ib.) לאותה הח' שהיא עתידה להיות ח' (pay attention) to that sick (nation), for she is destined to be sick (suffering). Cant. R. l. c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00347">
<head-word>חוּלְיָא, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<head-word>חוּלְיָה, </head-word>
<head-word>חוּלְיָי'</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">חֶלְיָה; חלי</xref>,
<xref rid="H01073"> cmp. חָלָל III; cmp. גִּלָּה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>loose part, something movable</italic>,] 
<italic>limb, link; vertebra of the spinal column</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bekh. VI, 5 בין ח' לח' (Talm. ed. 39
<sup>b</sup> מח' לח') between two vertebrae.—Ḥull. 52
<sup>a</sup> if a rib is displaced וח' עמה and a vertebra with it. Ib. 42
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Y. Succ. I, 51
<sup>d</sup> ח' של עמוד 
<italic>a segment</italic> of a column. Men. 38
<sup>b</sup> ח' 
<italic>a joint</italic> of the plaited show-threads.—
<plural-form>Pl. חוּלְיוֹת, חֲלָיוֹת</plural-form>. Kel. XI, 8 a chain שח' שלה וכ' the links of which are of metal stringed on &c. Ib. ח' של אבנים וכ' links consisting of jewels, pearls &c. Gen. R. s. 79, v. דְּיָקִינְתִּין. Ohol. I, 8 שמונה עשרה ח' eighteen vertebrae.—Bets. 22
<sup>a</sup> מנורה של חליות a candlestick which can be taken apart. Sabb. 46
<sup>a</sup>, v. חִדְקָא. Kel. V, 8; 10 חתכו ח' if he cut the burned clay of an oven into tiles; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>a segment of earth</italic> cut out in digging a pit and piled up on its borders; (collect.) 
<italic>the entrenchment around a well</italic> (increasing its capacity). Ber. 3
<sup>b</sup>; 59
<sup>a</sup> (prov.) אין הבור מתמלא מחוּלְיָתוֹ a pit cannot be filled up with its own earth, i.e. a community cannot live on its own resources. Sabb. XI, 2 (99
<sup>a</sup>) חוּלְיַת הבור (חוּלְיַית, Mish. חוּלְיוֹת, pl.) the entrenchment of a well. Erub. 78
<sup>a</sup>; Sabb. 99
<sup>a</sup> בור וחוּלְיָתָהּ (וחוּלְיָי') וכ' the depth of the well and its entrenchment are counted together to make up ten hand-breadths. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> בור תשעה … ח' if the pit was nine hand-breadths deep, and he took out of the bottom one segment (which had been cut before this). Ib. ונתן לתוכה ח' and threw a segment in. B. Kam. 51
<sup>a</sup> עקרו שניהם ח' וכ' both of them took the last segment out together, so as to complete the legal depth &c. Yoma 84
<sup>b</sup> עוקר ח' break loose one segment of the entrenchment; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>to make incisions</italic>)

<notes> Bekh. VI, 12 בעל ח' an animal afflicted with lichen. Ib. 41
<sup>a</sup> (expl. ילפת, Lev. XXII, 22) ח' המצרית Egyptian lichen; ח' דעלמא ordinary lichen.—Succ. III, 6 (34

<sup>b</sup> top רוח ח', v. תְּזָזִית.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00526">
<head-word>חֲזִי, </head-word>
<head-word>חֲזָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to see, recognize, to decide</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XXIX, 10; a. fr.—Ber. 45
<sup>a</sup>; Erub. 14
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. פוק חֲזִי וכ', v. דְּבַר. Ib. 13
<sup>b</sup> דחֲזִיתֵיה לר"מ וכ' (not דחזיתא) because I have seen R. M. &c. Ḥull. 59
<sup>b</sup> בעינא דאֶיחְזֵי וכ' I want to see your God Erub. 63
<sup>a</sup> ח' לנפשיה may examine the knife for his own use; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. חָזֵי, חֲזֵי, f. חַזְיָא (cmp. רָאוּי) 
<italic>pointed out, fit for, prepared;</italic> (
<italic>it is</italic>) 
<italic>proper</italic>. Targ. Job XV, 11. Targ. O. Lev. V, 10; a. e.—Keth. 21
<sup>a</sup> כְּדַחֲ', כִּדְחָ' as it is proper. B. Bath. 19
<sup>b</sup> ח' לבהמתו fit for his cattle as feed; a. fr.—Sabb. 90
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. למאי חזיא what is it good for (what use can be made of it)?—
<plural-form>Pl. חָזוּ, חֲזוּ</plural-form>. Ib. top ח' למתק וכ' they may be used for seasoning &c. Bets. 26
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—חזי לי it was pointed out to me, 
<italic>I saw</italic>. Gitt. 57
<sup>a</sup>. Taan. 25
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַחֲזֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to show, let see, reveal; to lay before a teacher for examination</italic> or 
<italic>decision</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XLI, 28; a. fr.—Ḥull. 59
<sup>b</sup> בעינא דמַחֲזִית וכ' I want thee to show it to me. Bets. l. c. אַחֲזַיֵיה לחכם וכ' as soon as he showed it to an expert (and the latter decided favorably) &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חַזֵּי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Targ. II Esth. II, 8.—B. Mets. 67
<sup>a</sup> ואודיק חַזִּיתָן איילונית and when he looked at me (and noticed that I was going to object by referring to אֹונָאָה), he pointed out to us the case of אַיְילֹונִית (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50; Ms. R. חַזְּתָן).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְחֲזֵי, אִיחֲזֵי, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, אִחְזֵי </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be seen, to appear</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Jud. XIII, 10; a. fr.—Ber. 17
<sup>b</sup> מִיחֲזֵי כיוהרא it looks like assumption; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to look at each other</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. O. Gen. XLII, 1.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become fit, adapted for use</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. 26
<sup>b</sup> אי דאִחֲזוּ בה"ש א' if on the entrance of the Sabbath they became fit for use, they have become so (for the entire Sabbath). Ib. אחזו והדר … אחזו they had been fit (on the entrance of the Sabbath), and were unfitted (through rain), and became fit again; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be shown, to be laid before the scholar for decision</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. אתח' לחכם וכ' it had been shown to (and decided upon by) the expert on the eve &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
